decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.5%, S&P 500 -0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is well below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we held rather than forcing a buy, letting the 7 existing positions ride under their automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.2%, indicating a quiet, directionless session rather than any sharp risk-off move. No major catalyst news was flagged for today's session. Light, mixed trading like this often reflects investors waiting for the next earnings or macro data point before committing more capital.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢平淡，納斯達克指數下跌0.5%，標普500指數下跌0.2%，屬於方向不明的窄幅波動，並非明顯的risk-off拋售。今日未有重大新聞催化劑。這種清淡混合的交易走勢，通常反映投資者在等待下一輪業績或宏觀數據公布後才願意加碼。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash on the sidelines instead of investing it immediately, so you have capital ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today's cash balance was below the usual buy threshold and the market gave no strong bullish signal, so holding cash was the disciplined choice rather than forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是先持有現金不急於投資，留待出現真正強勁的機會時才動用資金。今日現金水平低於一般買入門檻，而市場亦未出現明確的看漲訊號，因此按兵不動、保留現金才是較有紀律的做法，而非勉強交易。
